metadata.description: Successful profile retrieval by ID. Literal (not {id}-template) endpoint by design (collision sweep, 2026-08-05): TestGeneratedGetProfile requests exactly ID 12345, and this fixture is a field-decode-shape test double, not a live-captured canonical answer for GET /api/mdm/profiles/{id} -- profiles_get_apple_id.json is that canonical fixture. A literal endpoint gives this an exact-match win (beats template-match scoring) instead of relying on alphabetical tie-breaking among 4 same-scored fixtures, same pattern already used for the profiles/appleosx/winrt lifecycle-stage fixtures in this directory.
